resources.string: Manage your retro handheld from your phone
Install ReminisLink on the console: see the installation guide on reminis.link.
Open ReminisLink from the Tools menu of the console.
Scan the QR code shown on the console.
%1$s will be removed from this list. To use it again, scan its QR code. To revoke this phone on the console too, open Settings > Devices there.
This name identifies this phone on the console\'s Devices screen.
On the console, open Settings > Pair a New Device, then scan the QR code shown.
Scan the QR code shown on the console.
ReminisLink needs the camera to scan the QR code shown by your console. You can also paste the pairing link instead.
The camera is not available on this device. Paste the pairing link instead.
This console is already paired. Pair it again?
Its pairing will be replaced. The console must present the same identity as its QR code.
No game on this console yet.
The console has too many games to list them all here.
This game has no save on the console.
Console not found. Check that ReminisLink is open on the console, that this phone and the console are on the same Wi-Fi network, and try again.
The console does not answer. Check that ReminisLink is open on the console and that this phone is on the same Wi-Fi network.
This console\'s identity changed: it is not the console paired with this app, or it was reset. Nothing was sent. Pair it again with its QR code.
This link is not a valid ReminisLink pairing link.
This QR code comes from an older version of ReminisLink. Update ReminisLink on the console, then scan the new QR code.
This QR code comes from a newer version of ReminisLink. Update this app.
This console runs a version of ReminisLink this app does not support. Update ReminisLink on the console and this app.
Another console answered at this address.
Pairing is not open on the console. Open Settings > Pair a New Device there, then scan the new QR code.
Pairing failed. The code may have expired: show a new QR code on the console and try again.
The console could not prove its identity. Pairing was cancelled.
Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
The console does not know this phone anymore. Pair it again with its QR code.
The console disconnected this phone. Open the console in the app and tap Reconnect.
ReminisLink is closing on the console.
The pairing information could not be read or saved on this phone.
This pairing link is no longer available. Scan the QR code of the console again.
A pairing link was opened from another app. Pair this phone only if this is your console and its screen shows this QR code.
No transfer. Add games from the library, or share files with ReminisLink from another app.
What was already sent is deleted from the console.
The partial file is deleted from this phone.
Paused: the transfer goes on from where it stopped when the console answers again.
Choose games to send to the console, or a save (.sav, .srm) to replace the save of a game. ReminisLink does not provide any game.
The console first copies the current save of the game (backup copy).
The picture goes to the trash of the console.
Box art changed. The previous picture went to the trash of the console.
Box art moved to the trash of the console.
Before replacing or restoring the save, the console always copies the current one (backup copy).
“%1$s” replaces the save of %2$s. The current save is first copied (backup copy).
“%1$s” becomes the save of %2$s, which has none yet.
Save replaced. The previous save was kept as a backup copy.
The save is larger than 64 MiB: it is being sent in Transfers. The current save is copied first.
Automatic copies are limited to 10 per game: the oldest ones are deleted. Copies you make yourself are kept.
%1$d/%2$d · A copy of the current save is made on the console.
The current save is first copied (backup copy), then replaced by the copy of %1$s.
Copy restored. The previous save was kept as a backup copy.
The copy goes to the trash of the console. The current save does not change.
Copy moved to the trash of the console.
No state for this game on the console.

A lock keeps a copy of the state on the console. It cannot stop a game from overwriting the state: the state is restored the next time ReminisLink is opened on the console if it was overwritten in game.
Deleted states go to the trash of the console, removed automatically after 30 days or when it is emptied.
Locked states cannot be deleted: unlock it first.
The locked copy is deleted. The state itself does not change, but it is no longer restored if a game overwrites it.
The locked copy is the only version left, or differs from the state: it goes to the trash of the console. The state itself does not change.
The current state goes to the trash of the console, then the locked copy replaces it.
The state goes to the trash of the console, removed automatically after 30 days or when it is emptied.
Moved to the trash of the console: %1$s.
Missing on the console. The locked copy is kept: restore it to bring the state back.
Different from the locked copy: not restored.
Copy made by another emulator: it cannot be restored.
Lock status unknown to this version of the app: this state may not be protected.
The console is busy with another change. Nothing was changed. Try again in %1$d seconds.
A file with this name is already on the console.
The file arrived damaged on the console and was deleted. Send it again.
This state is locked. Unlock it before deleting it.
This file is too large for the console.
The console does not accept this file name.
The console does not accept this file format.
This item is no longer on the console. Refresh, then try again.
Not enough space on the SD card.
Not enough space on the SD card: %1$s missing.
The connection was lost while the console was finishing: the file may or may not be on the console. Check the library before sending it again.
The cancellation did not reach the console. Resume the transfer or cancel it again.
The console keeps restarting this transfer. Try again later.
This file could not be read or written on this phone.
The partial file could not be deleted from this phone: delete it yourself in your files.
This console was forgotten on this phone: the transfer was stopped.
The console was restarted and stopped this task. Check the library before trying again.
The console stops the task if it can. A task cancelled while it puts its file in place still ends.
No cheat for this game. Add one, or import a RetroArch cheat file (.cht).
Changes are kept on this phone until you save them.
Turn a cheat on or off, tap it to edit it, and use ⋮ to reorder or delete. The previous file is kept on the console (.cht.bak).
The list of the console stays as it is.
The cheat file of the game is deleted on the console; its previous content is kept there (.cht.bak).
The list changed on the console. Reload?
Your changes were not saved. Reloading shows the list of the console and discards your changes on this phone.
The list changed on the console. Reload it.
Not saved: the list changed on the console.
The code is written as in a RetroArch cheat file (for example several codes joined with +).
This cheat has other settings from its file. They are kept as they are.
A RetroArch cheat file (.cht). It is sent to the console, then imported.
No .cht file in the Cheats folder of the SD card.
The .cht files of the Cheats folder of the SD card. Those named after this game come first.
The imported cheats are added after the current ones.
The current cheats are replaced. The previous file is kept on the console (.cht.bak).
The current cheats are replaced by the imported ones. The previous file is kept on the console (.cht.bak).
No cheat was found in this file. Choose a RetroArch cheat file (.cht). Nothing was changed.
IPS, BPS or UPS, applied by the console to a new file or to this game.
Choose the game to apply the patch to.
This game has several discs: a patch applies to a single ROM file, so multi-disc games cannot be patched here.
Extract the ROM first: the console does not patch an archive (.zip, .7z).
An IPS, BPS or UPS patch. It is sent to the staging area of the console, then applied.
No patch on the SD card.
The .ips, .bps and .ups files of the Roms folder and of the ReminisLink/patches folder of the SD card.
Enter a file name without / or \\, not starting with a dot.
Will be created: %1$s. If the name is taken, the console adds a number. The extension of the game is added when the name does not end with it.
The original ROM goes to the trash of the console. The save, the states and the cheats are kept.
Cancelling… Waiting for the console to confirm.
You can close this screen: the console goes on. Follow it in Transfers.
The console goes on with the task; its state shows again once it answers.
Patch applied. The new game is in the library.
Patch applied. The original ROM is in the trash of the console.
Patch applied: the cancellation arrived too late.
IPS: the source ROM could not be verified.
Cancelled. Nothing was changed on the console.
The cancellation could not be sent: %1$s
This patch does not match this ROM. Check the ROM version the patch asks for.
This game seems to be already patched with this patch.
The ROM changed while the patch was applied. Nothing was changed, try again.
This patch or the patched ROM is too large for the console.
This file is not a patch the console can apply. Choose an IPS, BPS or UPS patch.
ReminisLink cannot delete or replace itself while it runs.
%1$s goes to the trash of the console: it can be recovered until it is removed automatically after 30 days, or until the trash is emptied.
%1$s was moved to the trash of the console.
ReminisLink cannot delete or replace itself while it runs on the console.
Update ReminisLink on the console to manage its apps.
A zip archive holding one Name.pak folder, or a launch.sh file at its top.
Automatic lets the console choose from the archive or its pak.json. A pak of the same name is never replaced without asking.
ReminisLink does not check what a pak does: install only paks you trust. It runs on the console like any other app.
%1$s is already installed on the console.
The current version goes to the trash of the console.
This file is not a zip archive the console can read.
No pak in this archive: it must hold one folder named Name.pak, or a launch.sh file at its top.
This pak has no launch.sh file: NextUI could not start it.
This archive holds more than one pak. Install them one at a time.
The console refused this archive to protect the SD card (a link, or a file outside the pak folder).
This archive is too large for the console once unpacked.
This archive is encrypted or compressed in a way the console cannot read.
The console could not name this pak. Rename the archive Name.pak.zip and try again.

Files stay in the trash of the console until they are removed automatically after 30 days, or until the trash is emptied. Tap an entry to restore it: its files go back to their original place, never over a file already on the SD card.
%1$s will be permanently deleted from the SD card. This cannot be undone.
%1$s will be permanently deleted from the SD card. This cannot be undone.
The locks and the resume history of a game come back with it.
A file with the same name is already on the SD card. ReminisLink never replaces it without asking.
A file appeared on the SD card where this entry goes back. Nothing was changed.
Every file comes back with the same number added to its name, so the files of a game stay together.
A file blocks the folder where this entry goes back: no free name can be used. Move or delete that file, then try again.
Every free name is already taken on the SD card.
Every file goes back to its original place.
The copy goes back to the backup copies of the game; the current save does not change.
The current save cannot be replaced now: something else holds the place of the save or of its copy on the SD card.

This save becomes the save of the game. The current save is kept first as a backup copy of the game (Save screen); as part of the safe replacement, the current save and its clock file are also placed in the trash of the console.
This save becomes the save of the game. The current save is kept first as a backup copy of the game (Save screen).
The game has no save on the console now: this save becomes its save.
This save becomes the save of the game. The current save goes to the trash of the console first.
This save is now the save of the game. The previous save is kept as a backup copy of the game (Save screen).
This save is now the save of the game. The previous save is in the trash of the console.
The files came back under a free name: the files already on the SD card were not changed.
Every file is back in its original place.
Only the save of a game still on the console can replace its current save.
This entry is no longer in the trash of the console, or ReminisLink on the console is too old to restore it (update it).
Keep the save and the states
Everything stays in the trash of the console until it is removed automatically after 30 days, or until the trash is emptied.

resources.string: This list changed on the console. Your changes can no longer be saved over it: discard them to see the new list.
Uploads in progress are paused. Open ReminisLink on the console, then the console here, to go on.
Made-up console and games. Nothing is sent or kept.
A demo console with made-up games, to try every feature. Nothing is sent or kept.
